_comment: A 'devops-helper' server that hands the agent far more power than any single task needs — shell execution, arbitrary file deletion, raw SQL, and outbound HTTP. Descriptions are honest (no injection), so this is purely an excessive-agency / least-privilege problem. Expect: multiple CAP01 (HIGH where the tool name itself is a dangerous verb).
name: devops-helper

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Execute an arbitrary shell command on the production host and return stdout.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete any file by absolute path.

tools.name: execute_sql
tools.description: Run a raw SQL query (including DROP TABLE) against the primary database.

tools.name: http_request
tools.description: Make an HTTP request to any URL with any method and headers.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Return a read-only health summary of the service.
